biggest_catch: You must be screened and qualify; the study involves oral and inhaled THC administration and requires 9-11 hours per session at Johns Hopkins Bayview Medical Center.
catches: Must be screened and determined eligible; not everyone qualifies.
Study involves oral and inhaled delta-8-THC and delta-9-THC, which carry medical and legal risks.
You must be a healthy adult aged 18-55.
Sessions require ~9-11 hours at Johns Hopkins Bayview Medical Center each; a major time commitment.

eligibility: Healthy adults ages 18-55; screening visit required to determine eligibility. All visits at Johns Hopkins Bayview Medical Center. Principal Investigator: Ryan Vandrey, PhD. Protocol #: IRB00394164.
notes: Announcement published 2025-07-09; enrollment currency not explicitly re-dated on the page, but the contact number and survey remain listed and the page is indexed as current.
numeric_basis: payout from official JHU Hub terms (up to $1,660 for 4 sessions / up to $3,320 for 8; no floor -> min 0); time: page states 4 or 8 sessions of ~9 or 11 hours; full path = 8 sessions x 9h = 4,320 min low, 8 sessions x 11h = 5,280 min high, plus an estimated ~4h (240 min) screening visit not separately itemized by the page

steps: Call 410-550-9491 or complete the survey linked in the official announcement to see if you may qualify.
Attend a screening visit at Johns Hopkins Bayview Medical Center to determine eligibility.
If eligible, complete four or eight drug administration sessions, each lasting about nine or 11 hours.
Receive payment: up to $1,660 for the first four sessions, up to $3,320 for all eight sessions.
timing: One screening visit plus four or eight drug administration sessions, each about nine or 11 hours.
